ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game vehicle sprite for the Thane T400: a very large four-wheel-drive ARTICULATED farm tractor, the kind that bends in the middle to steer, pulling wide ploughs across a hard-scrabble frontier colony's fields. Draw the BARE TRACTOR only, standing perfectly straight: no implement, no trailer. Image 1 is our approved smaller Thane T130 tractor from the same maker: match its outline weight, shading, harvest-green and muted yellow palette, cab roof, tyre treatment and linkage drawing only. Do NOT copy its shape.

Tall canvas, plain pure white background. North facing: the front of the tractor points to the TOP of the canvas. The tractor is centred left to right and fills about four fifths of the canvas width, and about nine tenths of its height, centred.

It is built in TWO HALVES joined by a clearly visible central pivot: a round steel hinge plate with a short steel coupling, exactly across the middle of the canvas, with a narrow gap of white between the two halves either side of it.

The FRONT HALF, top of the canvas: a long bonnet over a big engine with a grille at its front edge, a front weight block, a tall exhaust stack beside the bonnet, and at its rear a large square glazed cab roof with a flat pale grey top and two small rooftop beacons; two very large dual wheels on each side, four tyres side by side in pairs, with deep lugged treads, wider than the body.

The REAR HALF, bottom of the canvas: a short frame with a fuel tank deck, the same very large dual wheels on each side, and at its very rear the three-point linkage, two lower arms and a top link folded close in a triangle, with a heavy drawbar plate between them, all steel grey.

Maker palette as materials: harvest-green bonnet, frame and mudguards, a pale grey cab roof, dark rubber tyres, steel grey pivot, linkage, grille and exhaust, one muted yellow accent stripe along the bonnet.

Style: a top-down sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No implement, no plough, no trailer, no crop, no people, no animals, no dust, mud or damage, no text, letters, numbers, logos, dials or screens. No floor, ground, field, road, shadow outside the tractor, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
